articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 as Trump rules out Iran strikes, oil drops
articles.description: Bitcoin rebounded to $82,000 as Trump ruled out an Iran strike before the midterms, while crypto security experts pushed back on “bunker mode” fears.

articles.title: Top Democrat among Senate investigators probes ties between Cantor Fitzgerald, Tether
articles.description: As Democrats steadily rise in their potential to take back a Senate majority, Senator Richard Blumenthal is digging into Tether's U.S. financial partnership.

articles.title: Wall Street's tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin and ether, Citrini says
articles.description: The research firm sees tokenized stocks, bonds and loans creating new markets for trading and lending, with fee-generating platforms and companies poised to benefit.

articles.title: Crypto crumbles as anniversary of flash crash nears
articles.description: It was October 10, 2025, when bitcoin plunged from about $122,000 to $105,000, with much of the decline occurring within minutes.

articles.title: NFL joins pushback against prediction markets as U.S. Supreme Court asked to act
articles.description: In opposition to federal oversight of the prediction markets, the National Football League has sided with states, Gary Gensler and one of the authors of the relevant law.

articles.title: U.S. government moves $1 billion in bitcoin tied to Bitfinex hack, with no sign of sale
articles.description: Arkham data shows the 12,267 BTC went to unlabeled wallets rather than an exchange, a day after $383 million hit Coinbase Prime.

articles.title: EU securities regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
articles.description: ESMA said authorized platforms must block new access to stablecoins that fail to meet MiCA rules, while national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Digital assets outran stocks and gold in Q3
‘Bunker mode’ is a far greater challenge for institutions than individual crypto holders
articles.description: As crypto debates whether holders should move funds before AI or quantum advances expose wallet keys, custody firms face a separate problem: upgrading systems before an emergency migration.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation spins out Veridian, tokenizes its shares on new standard
articles.description: Veridian became the first company to use Cardano’s new programmable-token standard for its equity, though the tokenized shares are not being offered to the public.

articles.title: Over 6 million bitcoin sit behind exposed public keys as AI warnings mount
articles.description: Glassnode co-founder's latest figures show growing public-key exposure as Justin Drake urges preparations for potential AI attacks on wallet cryptography.

articles.title: Securitize brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana, with NYSE trading in the works
articles.description: Tokenized shares in the mega-caps will first trade on Securitize's Solana-based platform, with further plans to expand them to NYSE and OKXICE digital venues, the firm said.

articles.title: Bitcoin and ether holders urged to enter ‘bunker mode’ against possible AI attacks
articles.description: Ethereum researchers warned AI could break the signatures guarding bitcoin, ether and the tokens built on them "in months, not years" in the worst case, well before quantum computers arrive.

articles.title: NUVA brings U.S. residential mortgage credit to offshore investors
articles.description: The company's HOME token gives eligible investors exposure to a vault of U.S. home equity lines of credit starting from 1 USDC and targets a 7% annual yield.

articles.title: Bitcoin mined for pennies in 2010 moves after 16 years, now worth $8.5 million
articles.description: The 100 BTC came directly from two mining rewards created during Bitcoin’s “Satoshi era” and had not moved for more than 16 years.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips below $83,000 as Ethereum researcher's 'bunker mode' call divides crypto
articles.description: Justin Drake's call to prepare for an AI break of wallet cryptography drew a mixed response as bitcoin slipped below $83,000.

articles.title: Standard Chartered to expand institutional crypto and RWA custody to Singapore
articles.description: The bank would offer the service to institutions and accredited corporate investors, subject to regulatory requirements.

articles.title: Greece prepares to levy 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrency

articles.title: Samsung integrates USDC to overhaul cross-border remittances for 82 million Galaxy users

articles.title: Ripple is earning fees financing leveraged stock bets, a business long run by banks
articles.description: The crypto company's $1.25 billion acquisition of Hidden Road has opened a corner of Wall Street where funds pay to amplify daily moves in stocks such as Nvidia and Sandisk.

articles.description: Bitcoin-backed lending is evolving into a mainstream source of credit, with borrowers using BTC to access liquidity without selling.
